follow-up time: At 1 month, 6 months, 1 year, and yearly thereafter
exposure: Underlying mitral valve pathology (bioprosthesis degeneration vs. annuloplasty failure)
outcome: Need for surgical mitral valve replacement
cohort: 12 young women who underwent TMVI for mitral bioprosthesis or annuloplasty failure and were contemplating pregnancy
finding: Transcatheter mitral valve implantation (TMVI) in young women with failing bioprostheses resulted in good short-term outcomes and allowed for mostly uneventful pregnancies.
mod_finding: Four patients had full-term pregnancies with 2 vaginal and 2 cesarean deliveries, resulting in healthy newborns.
